QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Restored Trust
QuestInfo.0: Return to Skuas and give the helmet to Aruhi.
QuestInfo.1: As you give Aruhi the helmet you found in the Eyeful's treasure trove, he bursts into tears of relief at finally being proven right. Chief Kan and the villagers are speechless at the sight.
